verifier_note: Every url re-opened with the kit's fetcher on 2026-10-03; each page names the candidate in the office recorded, in the same county, city or district as the 2026 race. Corrections: Spencer County's source no longer cites the office's own site (not re-opened); Warren County's second source is described in words rather than by address. The Warren County Attorney's site still greets readers in the name of 'Amy Milliken' in its header while its About page and the Fiscal Court page name Amy Hale Chandler as County Attorney; the facts kept rest on those two.
note: The session's web-search allowance was used up before this part began (and one search engine answered with a CAPTCHA, left alone), so this part went only by fetching official county, city, school and court pages directly with the kit's fetcher. Not reached: Bourbon County's magistrates page (HTTP 429 three times), Bullitt and Marshall County sites (connection timed out), Lyndon's city site (403 to the kit's fetcher), Independence's city site (timed out), flemingcountyky.org (the address now serves an unrelated spam site, not Fleming County). Pages read that do not name the candidate as holding the office sought: Kenton County Fiscal Court (Benjamin Bach), Erlanger City Council (Don Skidmore), Boyd County Schools board (Aaron Prince), Crittenden County magistrates (Pamela A Todd; District 3 is held by another person), Woodford County Fiscal Court (Linda Shryock Popp; District 8 is held by another person), Robertson County (Stanley Henderson; another person is sheriff), Lyon and Nicholas County Clerk sites (Clayton Timmons, Amanda Kenney), Henry County elected officials (Jeremy Todd Chilton not named). The Legislature's House list shows House District 27 held by Nancy Tate and District 96 by Patrick Flannery, so Joseph Redmon and Pamela Lewis hold no seat there. Our record's incumbent flag is 0 for every candidate in this part, while the eleven below hold today the office they seek; county filing lists do not mark local incumbents, so this is noted here rather than filed as review items. No campaign websites were found (no search was possible). Darrell Butler II and Jeremy Duane Garmon (constables) were not researched beyond the county pages reached.
